scope: Named product examples, not a representative size distribution or acceptable-size limits. Product choices were made to cover category gaps, not to fit review preferences. Values describe assembled external envelopes, excluding loose cables. Dimensions use source units; diameter is repeated for two horizontal axes only for rotationally symmetric envelopes. Missing or ambiguous dimensions are not imputed.
selectionPolicy: Expand categories present in frozen source scenes using manufacturer product measurements. Include ordinary size/configuration variation where sourced. Product selection is not random and furniture examples remain predominantly IKEA. Category and pair coverage do not establish representativeness. No mean, quantile, or min/max of these products is a normality threshold.

unresolvedCategories.cap: Head circumference and brim length alone do not specify the worn or resting envelope.
unresolvedCategories.cereal box: A single retail box must be distinguished from a shipping case.
unresolvedCategories.coffee mug: Handle-inclusive width, body depth and height must all be verified. Capacity is not envelope volume.
